- [RLOW.13.9] **Series compiles to backend atoms and aggregation calls.**
  The compiler emits backend atoms ([RLOW.8.1.2]) and lowers every series
  read, a companion slot included, to its aggregation call ([RLOW.8.1.4]). It
  emits **no** rule for sample absorption: that is an engine step running once
  per pump after the agenda drains ([LSER.8.6], [RLOW.8.1.3]).
